# Coralgenz Global

> Coralgenz Global is an enterprise Information Technology, software engineering, and cryptographic systems company headquartered in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Specializing in high-performance digital products, client-side zero-knowledge security formats, certified cloud architectures, and startup co-engineering.

For the exhaustive technical specification, cryptographic proofs, leadership dossier, and complete dataset, read [llms-full.txt](https://coralgenz.net/llms-full.txt).

## Core Identity & Leadership
- [Homepage](https://coralgenz.net/): Enterprise IT solutions, custom software engineering, and corporate overview.
- [About Coralgenz Global](https://coralgenz.net/about-us): Corporate profile, history, mission, technology certifications, and engineering values.
- [Executive Team](https://coralgenz.net/team): Executive directory and software architects behind Coralgenz Global.
- [Karthick Krishna (CEO & Founder)](https://coralgenz.net/karthick-krishna): Lead Solutions Architect, cryptographic researcher, and inventor of the .secure format.
- [Thanvanth H (COO & Co-Founder)](https://coralgenz.net/thanvanth-h): Operations Director, agile engineering lead, and frontend specialist.
- [Sharveshwaran R (CTO)](https://coralgenz.net/sharveshwaran-r): Chief Technology Officer and principal cloud distributed systems architect.

## Proprietary Products & Inventions
- [World's First .secure File Format](https://coralgenz.net/our-highlights/worlds-first-secure-format): Browser-native, client-side zero-knowledge encrypted container powered by a 16-layer security model across 4 tiers.
- [Coralgenz Vault](https://coralgenz.net/coralgenz-vault): Zero-knowledge client-side file encryption suite, workstation, and secure in-memory document viewer.
- [Coralgenz QR](https://coralgenz.net/coralgenz-qr): Enterprise high-density dynamic QR generator with real-time routing telemetry and zero-cookie analytics.
- [Coralgenz Compiler Engine](https://coralgenz.net/coralgenz-compiler): Multi-language cloud code execution IDE supporting C, C++, Java, Python, and JavaScript in sandboxed runtimes.
- [Our Products Hub](https://coralgenz.net/our-products): Central showcase for all Coralgenz proprietary digital products.

## Official Enterprise Partnerships & Ecosystem
- [Microsoft Developer Partner](https://coralgenz.net/microsoft): Microsoft Collaborate member delivering Azure AI systems, cloud microservices, and enterprise DevOps.
- [Salesforce ISV Partner](https://coralgenz.net/salesforce): AppExchange solutions, 2GP managed packages, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Apex backend integrations.
- [Shopify Partner](https://coralgenz.net/shopify): Custom headless storefronts, Storefront GraphQL APIs, checkout UI extensions, and Liquid architecture.
- [Partnered Startups](https://coralgenz.net/partnered-startups): Startup co-engineering network featuring Zevionix Technologies (AI & Computer Vision) and Zorquelz Technologies (core product engineering, applied AI, cybersecurity).
- [Collaborated Products](https://coralgenz.net/collaborated-products): Strategic co-engineering alliance between Coralgenz Global and Zorquelz Technologies co-developing next-generation enterprise innovations.
- [Become a Partner](https://coralgenz.net/become-a-partner): Official partnership and co-engineering intake portal for startups, ISVs, and agencies.

## Enterprise Software Services
- [Our Services Hub](https://coralgenz.net/our-services): Full catalog of 8 core enterprise engineering services.
- [Custom Software Development](https://coralgenz.net/our-services/custom-software-development): Tailored enterprise applications, cloud backends, and microservices.
- [MVP Development](https://coralgenz.net/our-services/mvp-development): Rapid 4-to-8-week MVPs for funded startups and founders.
- [Full-Stack Software](https://coralgenz.net/our-services/full-stack-software): Scalable Node.js, Python, Go backends with React & Next.js frontends.
- [Frontend Modernization](https://coralgenz.net/our-services/frontend-modernization): High-speed UI/UX refactoring and 95+ Core Web Vitals optimization.
- [Progressive Web Apps (PWA)](https://coralgenz.net/our-services/pwa-development): Offline-ready web applications with native mobile capabilities.
- [Modern Admin Dashboards](https://coralgenz.net/our-services/modern-admin-dashboards): Real-time business intelligence and data visualization portals.
- [Domain & Cloud Deployment](https://coralgenz.net/our-services/domain-and-deployment-service): High-availability DNS, CDN edge routing, and automated CI/CD infrastructure.
- [Legacy Software Modernization](https://coralgenz.net/our-services/legacy-software-modernization): Zero-downtime microservice migration from legacy monoliths.
